to.description: This binary's latest step. state.json records it (with dry_run, would record it) unless state.json is listed in unconverted, which holds its number, or a rebuild of it was held by a sesshin.json in another format (listed in unconverted).

applied.description: The steps after from, up to to; empty when nothing was pending.

id.description: Its sesshin ID, when sesshin.json could be read, before or after conversion.

files.description: The file names converted, e.g. sesshin.json.

detail.description: Human-readable: why the steps couldn't convert it.
